messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - Keyline (enterprise, dedicated) - eu-west-1. High rate of 5xx responses from inference gateway. Paging on-call: @mike_oncall. Auto-escalation to ENG and CSM enabled.

mike_oncall: I'm on it, joining bridge now.

mike_oncall: quick triage — seeing a spike of 5xx starting at 16:02 UTC correlating with a config roll at 16:01 UTC (model routing / batching tweak).

tim_eng: confirmed. pool keyline-eu shows increased GPU OOMs and model-worker restarts. New config looks like it bumped batch size and disabled prefix caching for a subset of requests.

mike_oncall: rolling a quick rollback to previous model config to stop regen of errors.

mike_oncall: ```sh
# rollback config for keyline pool
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/deployments/rollback" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"pool":"keyline-eu","target_config":"config-2024-09-11"}'
```

tim_eng: applying. I'll tail the worker logs and watch OOM counters. If we still see errors after rollback, we'll force-route Keyline traffic to fallback model variant (lighter quantized).

emma_csm: Draft customer-facing message for Keyline operations / status page and email. Keep it concise and tailored:

emma_csm: ```
Customer-facing status (short):
We are investigating an issue impacting Keyline's dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1 causing intermittent 5xx errors for inferences. Engineers are rolling back a recent configuration change and routing failover is in progress. We expect most requests to be restored within 15-30 minutes.

What Keyline will see: some inferences may return 5xx or be delayed during the mitigation window. No customer data was exposed; this is a runtime availability issue.

Contact for updates: Keyline primary admin (Alice Chen) and Keyline SRE; your Redwood CSM (emma_csm) is coordinating customer comms. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

emma_csm: Keyline contact list we have on file (please confirm before sending):
- Alice Chen <alice.chen@keyline.com> (Primary admin)
- J. Morales <sre@keyline.com> (SRE)
- Escalation: keyline-oncall (pager) — we also have phone fallback.

olga_status: Status page blurb (short) ready to publish once we have rollback success: 

olga_status: ```
Incident: Keyline dedicated inference (eu-west-1) — high rate of 5xx responses.
Status: Investigating (Engineering rollback in progress).
Impact: Keyline dedicated customers may experience failed or delayed inferences.
ETA: 15-30 minutes for mitigation.
```

raj_se: Internal Slack/email snippet for account teams (copy/paste):

raj_se: ```
Internal: P1 impacting Keyline (dedicated, eu-west-1). Action taken: rolled back config to config-2024-09-11 and triggered routing to fallback quantized variant for Keyline traffic if errors persist. Oncall: @mike_oncall, Eng: @tim_eng, CSM: @emma_csm. Keyline contacts notified pending rollback verification. Track on incident bridge: <bridge-link>.
```

mike_oncall: rollback applied at 16:07 UTC. Initial metrics show 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 3% over last 2 minutes. Continuing to monitor P95 latency and OOM counters.

tim_eng: gating rule in autoscaler temporarily increased min-replicas for keyline-eu pool to handle warmup. If 5xx <1% for 5m, we mark mitigation successful and close bridge.

keyline_ops: Thanks team — Keyline SRE reports requests are succeeding again for most tests. Please confirm status page + email template and we will escalate to customer if we see new errors.

mike_oncall: publishing status page update now (olga, please push). Sending tailored email to Keyline once we confirm 10m steady state.

olga_status: Published: "Investigating, rollback in progress; mitigation shows initial improvement. Next update in 10 minutes."

mike_oncall: monitoring window started. If we see any regression we'll route traffic to fallback model and escalate to platform infra.

emma_csm: final customer email draft (to be sent after 10m stable):

emma_csm: ```
Hi Alice / Keyline team,

We experienced an availability issue impacting your dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1 earlier today. Engineers identified a recent config change that increased error rates and rolled back to the previous configuration. The rollback and temporary autoscaler adjustments have restored normal request success rates for most customers.

Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and higher latency between ~16:02 - 16:10 UTC.
Action taken: rolled back config, increased pool min replicas, monitored and validated recovery.
Next steps: we'll continue to monitor for 1 hour and follow up if any regression occurs. We will open a post-incident report with timeline and root cause.

If you want immediate details or a tech postmortem, let me know and we can schedule a call.

— emma (CSM)
```

mike_oncall: 16:17 UTC — 5xx now <0.5% and p95 good. Marking as mitigated; keeping bridge open for full hour.

keyline_ops: Confirmed — we're good on our end, will reach out if we see anything. Thanks for the quick response.

mike_oncall: closing message in 45 minutes unless new alerts. Postmortem owner: @tim_eng.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident transitioned to "Mitigated" state at 16:17 UTC. Postmortem follow-up due in 72 hours.
